note: Estimates from each provider's public pricing page, not a bill. Free tiers are not charged, so these are what the same tokens would cost at paid-tier prices. Re-check the pages just before the demo and update checked_on.

gemini-2.5-flash.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash
gemini-2.5-flash.status: Paid tier, text input. The pricing page marks this model deprecated: from 2026-12-01 requests route to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (same listed price). Figures read from a summary of the page; confirm on the live page.

openai/gpt-oss-120b.label: GPT-OSS 120B (Groq)
openai/gpt-oss-120b.status: Default Groq model. Cached input is $0.075 (not used here). It is a reasoning model: Groq's output token count includes its hidden reasoning tokens, so answers show more output tokens than words. The page does not say whether reasoning tokens are billed at the output price; this table assumes they are.

llama-3.3-70b-versatile.label: Llama 3.3 70B (Groq)
llama-3.3-70b-versatile.status: Groq shows 'Contact Sales' instead of a price for this model, so no cost is estimated. Fill in the two prices if Groq publishes them.

qwen3:14b.label: Qwen 3 14B (local)
qwen3:14b.status: Main local model, in the ollama container: no API fee, but it uses this computer's GPU/CPU, electricity and time.

qwen2.5:3b.label: Qwen 2.5 3B (local backup)
qwen2.5:3b.status: Runs in the ollama container: no API fee, but it uses this computer's electricity and time.
